recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Agricultural Science for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Iwena
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Land Use Act and Agricultural Land Tenure Systems in Nigeria
subtopics: The Land Use Act of 1978: Provisions, merits, and demerits
Land tenure systems: Communal, inheritance, leasehold, freehold, tenancy
Implications of land tenure constraints on commercial agribusiness
objectives: Explain key provisions of the Nigerian Land Use Act of 1978
Compare communal ownership with individual leasehold tenure
Propose legal reforms to enhance access to farmland for youth and women

topics.topic: Rock Weathering and Soil Formation Processes
subtopics: Physical weathering: Temperature fluctuation, frost, exfoliation
Chemical weathering: Carbonation, hydration, oxidation, hydrolysis
Biological weathering: Plant roots, burrowing earthworms, microbial decay
objectives: Describe the 3 major rock groups (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic)
Formulate chemical equations representing rock carbonation and hydrolysis
Explain the 5 factors of soil formation: Climate, parent rock, topography, organisms, time

topics.topic: Soil Profile Horizons and Soil Physical Properties
subtopics: Soil profile horizons: O, A, B, C, and D (bedrock)
Soil texture determination: Mechanical sieve analysis and feel method
Soil structure: Platy, prismatic, blocky, granular, and impact on aeration
objectives: Draw and label a complete vertical soil profile monolith
Calculate percentage composition of sand, silt, and clay in a soil sample
Explain how soil porosity influences water retention and drainage

topics.topic: Plant Nutrients, Nutrient Cycles and Soil Chemistry
subtopics: Macro-elements: N, P, K, Ca, Mg, S and their physiological roles
Micro-elements: Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn, B, Mo, Cl and deficiency symptoms
The Nitrogen Cycle: Nitrogen fixation, nitrification, and denitrification
objectives: Identify chlorosis and stunted growth symptoms caused by nutrient deficits
Diagram the cyclic biochemical pathway of atmospheric nitrogen into soil nitrates
Explain soil pH and methods of correcting extreme acidity (liming)
